quotes.text: Music is the space between the notes.
Works of art make rules; rules do not make works of art.
There is nothing more musical than a sunset.
Art is the most beautiful deception of all.
People don't very much like things that are beautiful and still less when they are superior to what they can make themselves.
To sum up: an artist can no more be tied to his art than a river can be tied to the banks of a river.
